data.name: Ruturaj
data.long_meaning: Rutu means season and Raja means king. This name signifies a ruler of the season or a king who brings about a change in the season.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name that signifies a spiritual ruler or a king who rules over spiritual matters.

data.cultural_impact: The name "Ruturaj" embodies the essence of power and control over the natural environment, which is deeply rooted in Hindu culture. In Indian mythology, gods and goddesses are often associated with the different seasons and natural elements. Ruturaj, as the ruler of the season, is a testament to this belief in the divine power of nature and the ability of humans to harness its energy.
data.spiritual_significance: On a spiritual level, "Ruturaj" signifies the inner ruler, the one who has control over the seasons of one's own life. It is a reminder to embrace change and transition, to acknowledge the cyclical nature of life and to approach each season with acceptance and openness. It encourages one to be introspective, to understand the rhythms of one's own inner world and to navigate life's ups and downs with grace and maturity. The name encourages one to be a leader in their own spiritual journey, to be the king of their own destiny, and to embrace the cycles of transformation that come with it.
